name: write_html
title: Writes with the same saver as write_xml

origin.description: Writes with the same saver as write_xml.
origin.example:
{h <- read_html("

Hi!

"); tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".xml"); write_html(h, tmp, options = "format"); paste(readLines(tmp), collapse = "\n")}

translation.description: Writes with the same saver as write_xml.
translation.example:
import tempfile; h = read_html("

Hi!

"); tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".xml", delete=False).name; write_html(h, tmp, options="format"); open(tmp).read().rstrip("\n")
